scope: Where the Rust rewrite's structure still differs from the Go owner it ports, from the 2026-11-22 file-level re-audit (method in structural-audit-2026-11-22.md).

findings.finding: ANALYZE is not in Go's shape. `real_tikv_analyze.rs` holds the planner's `buildAnalyze*` / `getMustAnalyzedColumns` and the executor's `AnalyzeExec`; Go's `AnalyzeExec` worker pool (`analyzeWorker`, `handleResultsError`, `handleGlobalStats`), `AnalyzeColumnsExec`'s sampling build (`buildSamplingStats`, `subMergeWorker`, `subBuildWorker`, `readDataAndSendTask`, `handleNDVForSpecialIndexes`), `analyze_idx.go`'s `fetchAnalyzeResult`, `analyze_global_stats.go` and `analyze_worker.go` have no counterparts. Done: globalstats' `MergePartitionStats2GlobalStats(ByTableID)`, `globalStatsMerger` and `WriteGlobalStatsToStorage` live in `tidb-stats-handle-globalstats/src/global_stats.rs`.
